title: minimap
summary: MSUI draws the md5translate-resolved outdoor tile plane and authored WMO interior tiles with separate exact six-level zoom laws, authored cluster controls, zone identity, tracking/mail icons, party/resource/quest/tracked-creature dots, cross-interior grey tint, and the corpse skull. AreaPOI landmarks use exact map/flag candidacy, 0.8 range split, signed-importance/distance nearest-three ranking, 8x8 POI cells and rotating real-art rim arrows. Outdoor tiles now receive the reference gamma-space diffuse/ambient day-night MODULATE with its +96 floor while WMO tiles stay white.

openItems.text: No interior (WMO) minimap: no portal flood-fill group selection, no interior tile stems, and no separate indoor zoom index/radius table {150,120,90,60,40,25} - indoors keeps showing the outdoor ADT plane
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: The existing WMO minimap path performs interior containment, authored tile-stem projection, portal/group preparation, separate zoom state and the exact {150,120,90,60,40,25} yard radius table. Registry was stale.

openItems.text: Outdoor zoom radii are ad-hoc (halfTile = 0.10 + zoom*0.025 tiles, ~53-120 yd) instead of the verified chunk table {14,12,10,8,6,4}*0.5*33.33 yd (~67-233 yd), so every zoom level shows a different world radius than 1.12
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Outdoor projection now uses the exact reversed-storage equivalent of Benilla's {14,12,10,8,6,4} chunk table, and both indoor/outdoor controls now share Benilla's increasing-index Zoom In convention.

openItems.text: AreaPOI landmark layer missing: no in-range POIIcons cells (Flags&2 rows) and no nearest-3 rotating rim arrows ranked by signed Importance within 694.44 yd
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: AreaPoiCatalog decodes the exact 29-field table and selects current-map Flags&1 candidates. Rows at or within 0.8 of the active radius draw Flags&2 Icon<64 cells from the 8x8 POI atlas; farther rows within 694.444 yd rank by signed Importance then distance, cap at three and draw the real rotating rim-arrow texture at the exact 0.8 rim. Landmark names join shared minimap tooltip ownership. Focused checks pass.

openItems.text: Quest-giver dots missing: DIALOG_STATUS 7 (REWARD2) never draws the gold cell-3 dot
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: status-7 NPCs draw an 8x8 ObjectIcons cell-3 gold dot, hard-culled at the active radius, with NPC-name tooltip ownership.

openItems.text: Quest-giver dots do not yet apply current Benilla's 0xffb0b0b0 tint when the NPC and player are on opposite indoor-containment sides.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: resource, tracked-unit and quest dots compare collision-backed WMO area containment at player and candidate positions and apply exact 0xffb0b0b0 on mismatch.

openItems.text: Focused laws and source wiring pass. Needs live traversal at all outdoor/interior zoom levels plus AreaPOI icon/rim-arrow art, ranking, rotation and tooltip checks alongside reward-ready quest NPC/resource/party layering.
Tracked-creature dots missing: Find Creatures / Hunter's Mark red cell-1 dots are not drawn (only the resource leg exists)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ObjectIcons cell 1 draws for PLAYER_TRACK_CREATURES type-mask matches and UNIT_DYNFLAG_TRACK_UNIT, with player Humanoid fallback, SpellShapeshiftForm creature-type override, range/aperture cull, tint and tooltip.

openItems.text: Outdoor tiles are drawn untinted - the reference's day-night MODULATE (ambient/diffuse lerp with +96 floor) is not applied
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MinimapUiLaw.OutdoorDayTint implements the exact gamma-space Rec.601 ambient luma, +96/256 white lift, then 0.25 diffuse + 0.75 lifted-ambient blend. DrawMovingMinimap packs that tint into every outdoor tile vertex; the authored WMO interior path remains full white. Focused checks pass.
2026-08-21: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY's display-map position draws POIIcons skull cell 7 at 0.11 of the minimap side inside the current 0.8 aperture.
